workflow.agent_system: shared AGENTS workflow for Codex, Claude and other agents
workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot only, <=8000 bytes. Report directly; delete generated test/build outputs after inspection. Preserve regression sources and user data.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap inference engine, Pen tracing with Shift-only angle snapping and auto-commit, segment bending (BendSegment) & multi-node curve conversion, Live Corners with 2x2 property bar, single-step undo batching, Knife/Eraser smart split tools, CAD circle/arc tangent construction. General filled-path Boolean uses pinned Clipper2 2.0.1 with bounded flattening, checked quantization, fill-rule preservation. Layout and Properties page-unit controls route semantic ActionIds.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Design files .pr only; schema v23-v25, containers v23-v26, reader v2-v26. LayerId/group/role hierarchy, raster table dedup, atomic chunk save; load memory-maps the container but still materializes decoded payload. Persists ICC/colors, raster graph, fidelity, text/layers/artboards, annotations/detail views. Persistent AVL map and hierarchy update compatible touched edits; structural changes rebuild. Partial raster source/sample dedup; crop-first and in-place pointwise evaluator; async edited RGB+A histogram.
current_capabilities.rendering: Windows ViewportRenderer uses Direct2D 1.1/D3D11 hardware or WARP; default hardware NativeWindow reads full BGRA frames for GDI. WARP defaults to HWND swap-chain direct present without full-frame readback; PIKDRAW_DIRECT_PRESENT=0 disables and =1 opts hardware in. GDI overlays are composited after D2D. Persistent D2D geometry cache keyed by object identity and path signature; persistent text geometry cache; non-zoom-dependent world-space BVH culling text/images/groups; 7 effect appearance model with GPU blur/shadow normal and software fallback.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32 Native Shell shares DIP paint/hit geometry and updates on DPI changes. Gradient Studio: interactive ramp slider, stop pins, midpoint diamonds, presets, reverse/distribute, screen-space canvas handles & live sync. Typography: granular delta mutations, Shift+F3 case cycling, linked frames, Combine/Split, Text on Path. PowerClip geometric editing with nested scopes. CorelDRAW/Illustrator shortcut profiles with input context guards and alignment precedence; mouse move coalescing.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService; MCP Streamable HTTP hosted in desktop process. NativeWindow E2E verifies AC01 600x300 mm Vietnamese layout/font/margins/colors/icons, stable IDs, edit/undo after reopen, 5x2m design, Settings revoke/stale-endpoint. AC02 RPC verifies atomic undo/redo IDs; AC07 RPC verifies 1,000-object paging. Stdio MCP sidecar with idle session TTL cleanup and Windows COM IDispatch local server. External mutations prune selection and refresh canvas.
current_capabilities.external_vector_import: CDR/PDF/AI/EPS import and DXF topology; PNG/BigTIFF and CMYK16 TIFF sample oracles. Safe DLL loading with LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32, bounded CDR stream quotas, ZIP bomb decompression ceilings, and AppContainer ACE cleanup. Production (in_progress): test sheets, TAC, CGATS/CSV ΔE00, .pdmr, WCS job hash. Integrated test, page U16, tiles/proof/plates, driver and physical print remain open.

known_limitations: Qt 6 and Skia backends are future architectural targets pending unified MinGW/MSVC toolchain ABI; runtime currently standardizes on Win32 Native Shell + Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 + WARP.

Interactive drag reuses cached canvas and dirty GDI copy, but changed snapshots still render/read back full-frame by default on hardware. WARP defaults to HWND swap-chain presentation and skips the CPU full-frame readback on the successful direct-present path; fallback still uses GDI. No GPU partial-render/raster tile evaluation. Direct-present visible behavior, DPI migration, FPS and input-to-present remain unverified.
DPI coverage uses synthetic 120/144/192/96 DPI events and native captures; physical monitor switching, reference-device latency and production fidelity remain unverified.

Auto-recovery writes use bounded jobs over immutable snapshots. Startup scan, selected recovery and UI .pr open run off UI thread. File load maps the container instead of allocating a second full-file vector; decompressed payload and DocumentSnapshot remain fully materialized, without streaming/lazy parsing. Atomic save streams payload and remains uncancelled for durability. Import/export run below normal priority with coalesced progress.
CDR uses pinned libcdr-to-SVG subset; PDF/AI use PDFium mapping and EPS uses eps-path-v1 or isolated Ghostscript conversion. Import pauses at 95% RAM and resumes after headroom returns.
TAC is diagnostic only; not auto-limited. Raster TAC uses RGB-to-CMYK ICC estimates; spot/raster plates, output-condition linkage, overprint and proof/gamut oracle remain open.
General path Boolean is a bounded polygon approximation: curve flattening and grid quantization produce an explicit error bound, but near-contact topology and manufacturing acceptance are not proven.
